Native source notices for IdealPlayer

index.json maps the unmodified notice files to their exact source archives or locked source components. Identical notice texts share one file named by its SHA-256. These files are also included in APK assets/licenses/native-notices.

This collection preserves upstream notices; it does not replace the corresponding source/build/relinking deliverable or claim distribution approval. The LibVLC full contrib build and Jellyfin software decoder remain enabled. See docs/SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION.md and third_party/native/README.md for scope and preparation.
